summary: Current intelligence reveals strong land development activity and strategic land ownership concentrated in Cleveland and Gaston counties, with significant builder presence primarily in Gaston, Mecklenburg, and Union. Cleveland County shows the highest watch scores on large parcels owned by LLCs, indicating strategic land banking. Gaston County presents numerous high-opportunity locate signals and land development proximity patterns around Bessemer City, aligning with active builder communities and recent utility locate requests. Union County's active legislative agenda reflects ongoing residential development and economic incentives, signaling growth and opportunity. GIS parcel data and builder activity confirm these counties as primary focus areas for land development, infrastructure planning, and telecom siting strategies.
key_findings: Cleveland County has multiple large parcels (300+ acres) under LLC strategic ownership with top watch scores (9), indicating high-value land banking activity.
Gaston County shows a cluster of high-opportunity locate requests (opportunity scores up to 15) and development proximity signals centered in Bessemer City with numerous tracked parcels nearby.
Union County demonstrates active residential development interest with multiple zoning changes, annexations, and economic development incentive requests scheduled for Board of Commissioners meetings.
Builder communities are active in Gaston, Mecklenburg, and Union counties with diverse single-family home projects, noted builder names include D.R. Horton, Eastwood Homes, and Taylor Morrison.
GIS parcel tracking in Brunswick is limited (100 parcels) with no recent high-priority signals reported.
